task.title: Install the Legacy App via the Command Line
task.shortdesc: Install and launch the legacy Python/Tkinter Portfolio Manager using the shell launch script or a manual virtual-environment setup. This method is suited for compatibility testing, Linux systems, and historical workflows that still use the Tkinter interface.

ul.li: Python 3.11 or later with Tkinter support
An internet connection for the initial clone

context.note: These steps install the legacy Python/Tkinter app. The current desktop app is the Tauri/React/FastAPI application; install it with the macOS app instructions or build it with the developer build guide. See .

step.cmd: Choose one of the following launch methods:

choice.p: Shell script (recommended): Run the launch script directly. It creates the virtual environment on the first run and installs all dependencies.
Manual virtual environment: Create and activate a virtual environment, then install the package and run the application.
choice.codeblock: python3 -m venv .venv source .venv/bin/activate pip install -e .[dev] python -m portfolio_manager

step.stepresult: The legacy app opens and initializes the database and configuration file at ~/.portfolio_manager/ on first launch.

postreq.p: To update, run git pull origin main in the repository directory. The launch script automatically installs any new dependencies on the next run.
